from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Represents the Total Assets data extracted from a single company's Q1 2025 financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the assets")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock exchange code for the company, e.g., '000006'")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="The reported Total Assets value as a number")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial figure, e.g., 'Yuan'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM format")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root class containing a list of all processed financial reports."""
    reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport] = Field(description="List of extracted company financial reports")
